title: Replying to @Delaney Sterling @Grace it’s the ending that seals it fo...
transcript: I have 100% seen this video of like Cornelia Street and you're Losing Me playing on top of each other and how they ultimately become a common response. I also, because I'm a fucking nerd, just went ahead and overlapped both of the songs in imovie to see like where they line up. For the most part, once you start getting into the choruses, it's all chaos. But there are some cool overlapping moments. Like the bridge to Cornelia Street starts ending as the bridge to Your Losing Me starts. But what really gets me is the ending, because Cornelia Street is technically 10 seconds longer on paper, but those last 10 seconds are silence. So if you overlap them, this is how they end. I don't know if that was intentional or not, but that just right here.
classificationReason: Reply-to-comment video continuing discussion from previous video about Taylor Swift/musical comparisons, not reviewing a stage production
